GitHub Issue: Post Date: 2024-02-28T20:01:31Z Current Date: April 4 2025 Title: Blazor Component (using RenderMode Interactive Server) - Incorrect Behavior on Navigating between pages, Component is not re-created Description: ### Is there an existing issue for this? - [X] I have searched the existing issues ### Describe the bug I have 2 pages, Page1, Page2. Both pages use the same Counter component with render mode: interactive server that is specified on the Counter components. `` NOTE: The Counter component inside its mark up does not specify render mode. Each page also contains a navigation link to the other page. When a user is on Page1 and increments the counter and then navigates (using anchor link) to Page 2 (that has also a Counter) the count is retained from Page1. Then, incrementing Counter on Page2 continues the count. When user navigates back Page1 (using anchor link) the count is now the sum of counts from Page1 and Page2. ### Expected Behavior I expect the component to be re-created and its state reset once a user navigates to another page from current page. That does not happen. The counter component appears to live (and retain its state) across page navigations using an anchor tag. _If this is the correct behavior for an interactive server side component using web socket connection in an SSR page then how can we re-use components across pages without retaining component state?_ ### Steps To Reproduce Create a sample SSR blazor app, select interactivity per component. Create 2 pages. Place Counter component on both pages. NOTE: Remove from the Counter component the "@rendermode InteractiveServer", instead place render modes explicitly where you use the counter on each page as: `` Add this mark up to navigate between the pages: `Go to page 2` `Go to page 1` Go to page 1, increment counter, use link to go to page 2 (observe the count is from page 1). Increment counter again and go back to page 1 (observe the count continues from page 2). ### Exceptions (if any) _No response_ ### .NET Version .net 8 Blazor SSR Interactive Server ### Anything else? _No response_ You must provide a category number (1-3). Your response must follow this format exactly: CATEGORY: [category number] REASONING: [your reasoning here, including specific reasons why an issue would be hard to dockerize if choosing category 3]
